answer: The wharf receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a haven seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. A pre-written answer bank thus goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 79 aliases trips the duplicate check at the ledge gate. A 277 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
